en: A colorized vintage postcard depicting a small neo-Gothic chapel-like structure on a sloping cobblestone street flanked by high walls and trees. The building has pointed arches, decorative pinnacles, and a steep spire with a cross on top. Below, the street descends toward a brighter open area in the distance. Printed captions in red at the bottom read the location and name of the site.
